site_name: Queens Head Public House, 8 Flamborough Street, London, E14 7LS
description: Listed Building Consent for removal of the railings from three dormer windows at east elevation, including refurbishing and redecorating the window frames and reveals in situ. The internal reconfiguration of second-floor rooms will involve refurbishing, altering partition walls, and redecorating.
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_: Planning application ref: PA/24/02031 & Listed building consent PA/24/02032 - Planning and listed building consent applications for: “Erection of a mansard roof extension to the existing self-contained flat at the rear of the site. Installation of two dormer windows to the existing mansard". Both applications were refused and are currently awaiting the outcome of appeal decisions.
